name: Filter
summary: Returns the characters of the text that also appear in the filter text, in their original order.

name: FilterValues
summary: Returns the values of a return-delimited list that also appear in the filter list.

name: GetValue
summary: Returns one value from a return-delimited list by its position.

name: JSONArray
summary: Constant naming the JSON array type for JSONSetElement and JSONMakeArray.
details: A JSON type constant used as the type argument by JSONSetElement or JSONMakeArray.

name: JSONBoolean
summary: Constant naming the JSON boolean type for JSONSetElement and JSONMakeArray.
details: A JSON type constant used as the type argument by JSONSetElement or JSONMakeArray.

name: JSONDeleteElement
summary: Removes an element from a JSON value by key, index or path and returns the changed JSON.

name: JSONFormatElements
summary: Returns a JSON value laid out with line breaks and tab indents.

name: JSONGetElement
summary: Returns one element of a JSON value, selected by key, index or path.

name: JSONGetElementType
summary: Returns the JSON type constant of an element, selected by key, index or path.

name: JSONListKeys
summary: Returns the keys of a JSON object, or the indexes of a JSON array, as a return-delimited list.

name: JSONListValues
summary: Returns the values of a JSON object or array as a return-delimited list.

name: JSONMakeArray
summary: Builds a JSON array from the values of a delimited list, converting each to the given type.

name: JSONNull
summary: Constant naming the JSON null type for JSONSetElement and JSONMakeArray.
details: A JSON type constant used as the type argument by JSONSetElement or JSONMakeArray.

name: JSONNumber
summary: Constant naming the JSON number type for JSONSetElement and JSONMakeArray.
details: A JSON type constant used as the type argument by JSONSetElement or JSONMakeArray.

name: JSONObject
summary: Constant naming the JSON object type for JSONSetElement and JSONMakeArray.
details: A JSON type constant used as the type argument by JSONSetElement or JSONMakeArray.

name: JSONParse
summary: Returns the text unchanged when it is a JSON object or array, otherwise "?" and the reason it is invalid in Tabularius's own wording.
differences: The exact wording used by Claris for invalid JSON is unverified.

name: JSONParsedState
summary: Reports the parsed state of a value: 0 if it was never parsed, -1 if parsing found it invalid, otherwise its JSON type constant.

name: JSONRaw
summary: Constant naming the JSON raw type for JSONSetElement and JSONMakeArray.
details: A JSON type constant used as the type argument by JSONSetElement or JSONMakeArray.

name: JSONSetElement
summary: Sets one element of a JSON value, by key, index or path, and returns the changed JSON.

name: JSONString
summary: Constant naming the JSON string type for JSONSetElement and JSONMakeArray.
details: A JSON type constant used as the type argument by JSONSetElement or JSONMakeArray.

name: LeftValues
summary: Returns the first values of a return-delimited list.

name: List
summary: Joins its arguments into a return-delimited list, skipping empty arguments.

name: MiddleValues
summary: Returns a run of values from the middle of a return-delimited list.

name: RightValues
summary: Returns the last values of a return-delimited list.

name: SortValues
summary: Sorts a return-delimited list.

name: UniqueValues
summary: Returns a return-delimited list with repeated values removed.

name: ValueCount
summary: Counts the values of a return-delimited list.

name: ValueListItems
summary: Reads the named value list from the current file context; the result depends on file state.
differences: Value-list contents require a file context and are unverified here.
